content.text: Sets the project's licensing terms so individuals and companies can use it freely, while blocking competing hosted resale.

bullets: Adds a license and README documenting usage rights; no application behavior is touched.

items.role: Legal terms governing use of the project
items.change: New Business Source License 1.1 with a no-competing-hosted-service grant, converting to Apache 2.0 on 2030-09-24.
New file describing the project's purpose and summarizing the license: free internal use, no competing SaaS, Apache 2.0 conversion.

annotations.note: Additional Use Grant: production use is free, including internal use, but offering it to third parties as a competing hosted or managed service is barred.
Change Date 2030-09-24 and Apache 2.0 as the Change License; the terms say each version converts on this date or four years after its release, whichever is first.
Boilerplate covenant requires the Change License to be GPL 2.0-compatible; Apache 2.0 is chosen. Worth confirming that this compatibility claim holds.
Plain-language license summary; it must stay consistent with the LICENSE grant and dates.
